title: Find a precisely bound capture
responsibility: Finds a listed capture by its complete evidence binding and identifies the record holding its bytes.

inputs.name: recordedCapture.evidence
inputs.description: The entity’s before/after evidence, already read at the intended revisions.

inputs.name: recordedCapture.binding
inputs.description: The requested side, judging-record identity, scenario, state, evidence identifier, nullable viewport and SHA-256 hash. Every field must match the selected evidence.

outputs.name: recordedCapture
outputs.description: The listed capture and its scenario’s origin-record identity. Inherited captures therefore point to the record that originally stored them. The helper selects a record; it does not read or hash bytes.

errors.name: capture-unlisted
errors.description: Throws when the chosen side or judging record is absent, no capture matches the entire binding, or that record has no matching scenario.
